crossRefs.note: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by…
You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that…
For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
But Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for…
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…

translations.web: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
translations.bsb: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
translations.kjv: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
translations.asv: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.
